title: In-game monitoring of adolescent handball players: a preliminary examination of associations between external load parameters and objective and subjective fatigue markers
why: One Bundesliga-level youth match, 11 adolescent handball players (8 complete cases): Kinexon LPS external load vs fatigue markers. RPE rose 8.0→14.6→16.1 and PRSS fell 8.25→6.12→4.75, both associated with load; the leg recovery test stayed largely unchanged. Preliminary, n=8.
